---
title: "5. Optimisation, Algorithms and Complexity"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 12 weeks  
**Outcome:** Translate mathematical problems into algorithms and reason about tractability.
:::

## Core topics

Convexity; gradient methods; duality; KKT; linear/quadratic programming; data structures; graph algorithms; dynamic programming; network flow; P/NP/NP-hardness; approximation.

## Essential resources

- Boyd, S., & Vandenberghe, L. (2004). *Convex Optimization*. <https://web.stanford.edu/~boyd/cvxbook/>
- MIT **6.006: Introduction to Algorithms** — <https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-006-introduction-to-algorithms-spring-2020/>
- MIT **6.046J: Design and Analysis of Algorithms** — <https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-046j-design-and-analysis-of-algorithms-spring-2015/>
- Cormen, T. H., et al. (2022). *Introduction to Algorithms* (4th ed.). MIT Press.

## Milestone

Implement matching, shortest-path, max-flow and optimisation algorithms, then solve a constrained economic allocation problem.
